description:
Step 1 of the R2 page (/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-9zq.2.html). types/clash.rs: Head::Tuple holds the first slot's atom type, so {acc, x} (tag :other then none) and an alternating {:l, acc} / {:r, acc} never find a covering frame and never fold. A self recursion that changes its tag hangs on develop (mix/2 below).

Change: Head::Tuple(usize, Option<String>); a clause whose first slot is a finite set of atoms yields one head per atom, any other first slot the untagged head; Pf::covers accepts a tagged head when it holds the untagged head of that arity; apply_plan matches a cut against any of a clause's heads.

Measured at 32a14dda4 (scratch 9zq_2/fresh/LG2.diff, clash.rs part; gate_G.log): full gate green, no pin moved, distiller 16.02B instructions against 16.04B.

Probe: def mix(0, acc), do: acc; def mix(n, acc) when rem(n, 2) == 0, do: mix(n - 1, {:l, acc}); def mix(n, acc), do: mix(n - 1, {:r, acc}); mix(3, :a) prints {:r, {:l, {:r, :a}}}.

Also: un-defer the return_tuple_accumulator fixture if it runs on all three paths.
title: A tuple's clash head is its arity and one tag, and an untagged head covers a tagged one
